title: News post (data/news/<YYYY-MM-DD>-<slug>.yaml)
description: T4.3: a news post of the website, published with the client build. The file name gives its date and its slug (the URL /news/<date>-<slug>). Title and body are written in every language here, not in i18n/. The body is a minimal Markdown subset rendered as text (docs/06-content-data.md, "Noticias"): paragraphs separated by a blank line, lines starting with "- " as a list, **bold** and *italics*. No HTML and no links.

date.description: Publication date (YYYY-MM-DD); must match the file name.
